events.POTION_TASTING.title: 药水试饮会
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.INITIAL.description:
一阵奇怪的甜味引你来到一个药水摊前。系着围裙的蝾螈正搅动一口冒泡的锅，桌上摆着几瓶[gold]五颜六色的药水[/gold]。

“一瓶免费！想多带一瓶，就拿金币，或者拿你自己的来换。”

它指了指你腰间的瓶子。
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.INITIAL.options.BAR: 失去[red]1[/red]瓶[gold]药水[/gold]。获得[blue]2[/blue]瓶随机[gold]药水[/gold]。
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.CHOOSE_FREE.descrip:
[green]“挑一瓶。”[/green]

蝾螈擦了擦每个瓶口。
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.CHOOSE_BUY.descript:
蝾螈把瓶子推近了一点。

选好两瓶后，支付[gold]{Gold}金币[/gold]。
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.CHOOSE_BARTER.descr:
蝾螈把三瓶药水排好。

[green]“先挑你要的，再让我看看你的。”[/green]
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.PAYMENT.description:
蝾螈放下勺子，向你伸出手。

“让我尝尝你的。”
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.SAMPLED.description:
蝾螈随手从柜子里拿出一瓶药水，在围裙上擦了擦，塞到你手里。

“下次再来！”
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.BOUGHT.description:
你把[gold]金币[/gold]放到桌上。蝾螈从柜子里摸出两瓶药水，一起递给你。

“别混着喝。我还没试过。”
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.BARTERED.descriptio:
蝾螈接过你的药水，凑到鼻子下面闻了闻。

“好东西！”

它把瓶子收起来，换给你另外两瓶。
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.WATER.description:
你摇了摇头。蝾螈耸耸肩，从锅边舀了一杯热水。

你小心地喝完，身子总算暖和了一点。

events.POTION_TASTING.title: Potion Tasting
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.INITIAL.description:
A strange, sweet smell leads you to a potion stall. A newt in an apron stirs a bubbling pot beside several [gold]colorful bottles[/gold].

“One is free! For another, bring coins. Or trade one of yours.”

It points at the bottles on your belt.
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.CHOOSE_FREE.descrip:
[green]“Pick one.”[/green]

The newt wipes the mouth of each bottle.
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.CHOOSE_BUY.descript:
The newt nudges the bottles closer.

Choose two, then pay [gold]{Gold} Gold[/gold].
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.CHOOSE_BARTER.descr:
The newt lines up the three bottles.

[green]“Pick the ones you want. Then show me yours.”[/green]
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.PAYMENT.description:
The newt puts down its spoon and holds out a hand.

“Let me try yours.”
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.SAMPLED.description:
The newt grabs a potion from the cupboard, wipes it on its apron, and presses it into your hand.

“Come back soon!”
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.BOUGHT.description:
You place the [gold]coins[/gold] on the table. The newt fishes two potions out of the cupboard and hands them over.

“Do not mix them. I have not tried that yet.”
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.BARTERED.descriptio:
The newt takes your potion and holds it beneath its nose.

“Good stuff!”

It puts the bottle away and hands you two others.
events.POTION_TASTING.pages.WATER.description:
You shake your head. The newt shrugs and ladles a cup of hot water from beside the pot.

You drink it carefully, grateful for a little warmth.
